name: compass-orientation
description: PARITY-NORTH: the 3D nav compass needle must track scene North (orientationDeg), not just camera heading. Probe the needle SVG transform at orientation 0 vs 90.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: read-90
steps.eval: (()=>{const g=document.querySelector('.compass-cell svg g');const t90=g?g.getAttribute('transform'):'none';const num=s=>parseFloat((s||'').replace(/rotate\(([-0-9.]+).*/, '$1'));const r0=num(window.__t0),r90=num(t90);let diff=r90-r0;diff=((diff%360)+360)%360;console.log('PROBE compass t0='+window.__t0+' t90='+t90+' diffMod360='+diff);return 'done';})()
